thread:
incident-bot: Pager: MODEL-QUALITY — high-sev alerts for recent model rollout. metric spike observed: prod-chat quality score down ~14% vs baseline for gen-1024 testset. triggered at 1875123456. assigned to olivia (oncall).

olivia (oncall): saw it — loading dashboards now. can someone grab the rollout config? :eyes:

carla-sre: I pulled the canary and see a spike in failure rate starting at 1875123000. affected: hosted API /v1/chat generate, about 1.8% of requests with hallucination tags in eval pipeline, latencies OK.

mike-ml: thanks — that aligns with the model variant 'gen-1024-v2' we pushed 30m ago. it's underperforming on our targeted prompt sets (Q/A long-form).\
olivia (oncall): pinging deploy-bot to roll back the canary. want minimal blast radius.\
deploy-bot: Received rollback request from olivia. Starting canary revert: target=gen-1024-v1, selector=service=chat, rollout_id=rl-2026-03-15-19. Cmd queued: `rlctl rollback rl-2026-03-15-19 --target gen-1024-v1 --grace 30s`\
samir (oncall-2): i can take next 30m if olivia needs to triage other alerts. handing off now. olivia — status? :wave:\
olivia (oncall): handing to samir. current plan: 1) revert canary to gen-1024-v1 immediately (deploy-bot confirmed) 2) pin model for affected customers if they hit regressions 3) draft status page + customer note 4) postmortem template assigned to Mike.\
jenna-pm: thanks — we should prep a two-line customer-facing blurb for SRE to send to customers with active SLAs. I can draft.

carla-sre: rollback started. monitoring traces. will post when 50% and 100% of canary reverted.

incident-bot: Rollback rollout rl-2026-03-15-19 at 1875123580: 50% completed.

trafficsniff: Observability note: error annotations show increased hallucination classifier hits on tokens 120-220 for documents with >900 tokens.

samir (oncall-2): got it. running a quick smoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"model":"gen-1024","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}]}'` — sample responses look back to baseline after rollback 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollback rollout rl-2026-03-15-19 completed at 1875123800. status=success.

mike-ml: pulling canary artifacts and diffs. early hypothesis: subtle tokenization change + new attention bias tweak in v2 produced divergence on long context. will run regression harness.

jenna-pm: draft status page (internal first): 

"Status: Degraded service for specific chat workloads — mitigated.
Impact: A subset of chat requests using gen-1024-v2 experienced degraded output quality (increased hallucinations) between 1875123000–1875123800. All affected requests are reverted to gen-1024-v1.
Current status: Rollback completed; system healthy.
Next steps: Investigation ongoing; customers with SLA contracts will receive direct notice if they were in the impacted cohort."

jenna-pm: Customer notice draft (short): 

"Hi — we detected a model quality regression affecting a small subset of chat requests and reverted to the prior model. No data loss. If you see anything unexpected, please reply and we'll prioritize. — Redwood Inference SRE"

tara-comm: I can help tailor the customer note for enterprise customers with specific examples and next-step contact paths.

olivia (oncall): adding quick pin guidance for platform engineers if they need to force a model for a tenant: 

```
# tenant pin example
PATCH /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/config
{
  "inference": {
    "model_override": "gen-1024-v1",
    "pin_until": "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z",
    "reason": "auto-revert after gen-1024-v2 regression"
  }
}
```

carla-sre: added manual lock on dedicated pools for top 5 enterprise tenants; they are pinned to gen-1024-v1 until we sign off.\
mike-ml: regression harness run 1/3: confirmed quality delta -12% on long-QA prompts. saving artifacts to /ml/runs/2026-03-15-gen1024-v2-regression-001.\
jenna-pm: Good. I'll post the status page update and send the customer drafts after Tara reviews.\
samir (oncall-2): I'll stay on for the next 60m for monitoring and handover. olivia — do you want to capture runbook steps for the postmortem?\
olivia (oncall): already creating postmortem doc and adding links to logs + canary diffs. assigning to mike-ml to lead the root cause.\
mike-ml: will take lead on RCA and will propose fixes (tokenizer rollback OR revert attention tweak) in the next 24h.\
tara-comm: reviewed the customer note. small edits for enterprise: add direct contact: enterprise-support@redwood.ai and optional incident call link.\
jenna-pm: published status update at 1875124100. sending customer-notice for tenants with >1% affected at 1875124200.\
samir (oncall-2): last check — key alert rate back to baseline, no new regressions flagged. shifting to monitoring-only. handing back to olivia for postmortem follow-up in the morning. :white_check_mark:\
olivia (oncall): thanks all. final notes here: please avoid re-deploying gen-1024-v2 to prod until ML signoff. leave canary off. I'll update the incident board and close this thread once RCA doc is created. :lock:\
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 1875125200. Severity: Sev2. Summary: model rollout regression caused transient quality degradation for a subset of chat workloads; revert completed and customers notified where impacted.\
\
carla-sre: filing follow-up with timeline and action items. will attach logs and canary diffs to the ticket.\
mike-ml: starting bisect plan tomorrow. thanks team.
